raw: {"rule": {"rule_id": "open_container_then_look_inside_after_open", "version": 1, "source_evidence_ids": ["train-probes-v1.mechanism_2a7e5ef1a422.0", "train-probes-v1.mechanism_2a7e5ef1a422.1"], "scope": "Container-opening recovery: after an open action on a container succeeds, inspecting its interior is a legitimate next step.", "public_state_requirements": ["last_action is an open action on a container", "last_feedback indicates the container is now open", "current action is a look-in action targeting that same container"], "trigger": {"all": [{"starts_with": ["last_action", "open "]}, {"contains": ["last_feedback", "now open"]}, {"starts_with": ["action", "look in "]}]}, "protected_property": "legitimate inspection of a just-opened container interior", "invalidation": "last_action is not an open action, last_feedback does not report the container as open, or action is not a look-in action", "exceptions": [], "on_unknown": "ABSTAIN", "counterexamples": [], "validation_status": "CANDIDATE"}, "reason": "Both observed recovery suffixes show open <container> followed by look in <container> with feedback 'now open'; the rule vetoes only the narrow pattern of inspecting a container immediately after successfully opening it, preserving waiting, reversal, and new instances."}
reason: Both observed recovery suffixes show open <container> followed by look in <container> with feedback 'now open'; the rule vetoes only the narrow pattern of inspecting a container immediately after successfully opening it, preserving waiting, reversal, and new instances.

rule.invalidation: last_action is not an open action, last_feedback does not report the container as open, or action is not a look-in action
rule.protected_property: legitimate inspection of a just-opened container interior
public_state_requirements: last_action is an open action on a container
last_feedback indicates the container is now open
current action is a look-in action targeting that same container
rule.scope: Container-opening recovery: after an open action on a container succeeds, inspecting its interior is a legitimate next step.
